pokedexEntries.dp: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.

pokedexEntries.pt: Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.

pokedexEntries.hg: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

pokedexEntries.ss: The beat of its wings is so powerful that it accidentally dislodges full-grown trees when it takes off in flight.

pokedexEntries.bw: Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes’ heads instantly while flying by at high speed.

pokedexEntries.x: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes’ heads instantly while flying by at high speed.

pokedexEntries.or: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes’ heads instantly while flying by at high speed.

pokedexEntries.y: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

pokedexEntries.as: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.

pokedexEntries.la: Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey’s most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.

pokedexEntries.sc: Yanmega's wingbeats are so powerful that the Pokémon blows down huge trees nearby when it vigorously launches itself into flight.

pokedexEntries.vi: Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.
